blind.description: A stylized wooden forge bellows mounted on a four-legged wooden stand. It consists of a teardrop-shaped accordion bellows with maroon leather folds accented with brass studs, sandwiched between wooden plates. A long wooden pump lever with a turned handle is hinged along the top via a metal pivot bracket. A tapered metal nozzle extends from the front. The supporting frame has four square wooden corner posts connected by dark green crossbeams with metal corner brackets.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a teardrop-shaped wooden bellows body nestled within a rectangular frame defined by four square corner posts, crossed lengthwise by a wooden lever arm connected to a central metal hinge, terminating in a turned handle at one end and a metal nozzle pointing downward at the other.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall), with a footprint roughly 3 feet long and 1.5 feet wide.
